QF.id: VII Other Services Provided by Brokers_1

explanation.text: The Logic: ASBA stands for Application Supported by Blocked Amount; the money remains blocked in the investor's bank account until allotment. The Trap: Under ASBA the amount is blocked, not debited, and is debited only to the extent of the allotment value once allotment is finalised. Note: ASBA has been mandatory for all public issues opening on or after 01 January 2016.
